data.summary: The catalog directory holds configuration files for data lake catalog connectors, specifically defining Iceberg REST catalog connections and S3 storage settings.

file_insights.name: iceberg.properties
file_insights.summary: Configuration file for connecting an Iceberg connector to a REST catalog and MinIO S3 storage.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines key-value configuration properties for the Iceberg connector, including REST catalog type, URI, native S3 enablement, endpoint, region, path-style access, and AWS credentials for MinIO.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains Trino/Presto or Spark configuration properties for connecting to an Iceberg REST catalog and a MinIO S3-compatible object storage backend. Defines parameters such as connector type, catalog type, REST catalog URI, and S3 endpoint/credentials.
responsibilities: Specify REST catalog URI and type
Configure S3-compatible storage endpoints and credentials
